Subject: Your ChangeWatch monitoring is active

Hello {{client_name}},

Your ChangeWatch monitoring is active. We monitor {{page_count}} competitor pages at this frequency: {{monitoring_frequency}} (timezone: {{timezone}}).

The initial baselines have been recorded. Price changes, product additions or removals, promotions, and shipping or availability changes can trigger an alert.

Only meaningful changes meeting the {{alert_threshold}}/100 threshold and our reliability checks generate an email. Some changes need more than one observation before confirmation. Receiving no email does not mean monitoring has stopped.

Alerts are monitoring signals: verify the source page before making an important decision. To change a monitored page or report a problem, contact {{support_contact}}.
